iPhone 18 Pro 同 Pro Max will launch next month, and besides coming with several new features, they are also reportedly set to include three design changes. Here is what is expected based on the rumors.

#1: Unified rear glass and aluminum edge colors

Among the many design changes of the iPhone 17 Pro, the colors were clearly very popular, and no one seemed to mind the full-width camera plateau.

However, one design decision caused more controversy: the two-tone rear glass and aluminum edge.

Fortunately, Apple is reportedly planning to address this issue with the iPhone 18 Pro.

Weibo leaker Instant Digital wrote:

I am one of those users who thinks the two-tone design looks unattractive, so I am really looking forward to seeing Apple change direction with the iPhone 18 Pro.

#2: Smaller Dynamic Island

Apple first introduced the Dynamic Island with the iPhone 14 Pro four years ago. Since then, although there have been many rumors that Apple is working on a smaller design, the Dynamic Island has remained unchanged.

However, the iPhone 18 Pro launching next month will finally feature a new Dynamic Island design.

Reports suggest the new Dynamic Island will shrink by about 35% on the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max.

Some Face ID components are reportedly being moved under the display, but not all of them. So Apple has not switched to a punch-hole design—at least not yet.

#3: New colors, led by Dark Cherry

Apple did something surprising with the iPhone 17 Pro: it offered bold and fun color options.

Cosmic Orange in particular was hugely popular, proving that Apple was right to move away from basic white, black, and gray color schemes.

The company is reportedly planning to continue offering fun color options for the Pro models with the iPhone 18 Pro. At least three colors are currently expected:

  • Dark Cherry
  • Silver
  • Light Blue

There are differing reports on whether Space Gray/Black will return this year, but it could be the fourth color.

"Dark Cherry" is described as a blend of burgundy, coffee, and deep purple. It is expected to be Apple's main marketing color.

What do you think of Apple's rumored iPhone 18 Pro design changes? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
